name: ansariaiwp/wp-plugin-factory
description: WordPress Plugin Factory: a spec-driven scaffold + module system for generating production-grade WordPress plugins.

scripts.lint:syntax: find scaffold modules tools -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 -P4 php -l

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run WordPress Coding Standards + PHPCompatibility checks across scaffold/, modules/ and tools/.
scripts-descriptions.validate-spec: Validate a plugin spec JSON file against spec/plugin-spec.schema.json.
scripts-descriptions.compose-plugin: Compose scaffold + selected modules from a spec into /build/<slug>/.
scripts-descriptions.build: Validate, compose, lint and zip a plugin from a spec into /build/<slug>-<version>.zip.
scripts-descriptions.new-module: Scaffold a brand new, empty module folder following MODULE-SPEC.md.
